Added dep N22a-01 (controller/state-source save/load used for restore component 6).

Title said T4.1 to T4.7 but T4.7 is BD-093's. The refinement law was said to be implemented by BD-083; it is N16c-01's (which depends on this bead, so a hook, not a dep). The accumulation test claimed the restitution-0.5 ball from 1 mm trips E_max = 64; recomputed: impacts accumulate at 42.835 ms and the gap falls below one 30.5 ns cell after about 14 impacts in that base interval, so the level clause (L_max) fires; test corrected and a separate 65-touchdown fixture added for the count clause.

The heavy-top fixture at nutation 90 degrees lowers the spherical pivot to three one-axis joints; a yaw-pitch-roll order sits exactly on its gimbal singularity there. Fixed the order (vertical, nodal, symmetry axis; singular only at 0 and 180 degrees) and the lint that refuses the singular one. Other numbers recomputed and correct (T = 2.1540 s, K(1/2) = 1.68575, Omega = 4.905 rad/s, 2R values).
